# Verified lessons

Short, evidence-backed facts that will matter again. No secrets, webhook URLs,
personal data, or guesses. Add entries with the `project-remember` skill;
remove ones that stop being true. Add new entries above `## Entry format`.

## Entry format (template — do not edit in place)

```markdown
- **Fact:** one sentence.
- **Evidence:** file, command, or commit that shows it.
- **Verified:** YYYY-MM-DD
```
